name: modresorts-css-minification
description: CSS minification pipeline for ModResorts AWS CodePipeline with S3 and CloudFront CDN delivery (cr-css-1005)

scripts.minify:css: npm run minify:styles && npm run minify:pikaday
scripts.prebuild: echo 'Starting CSS minification for AWS CloudFront CDN delivery (cr-css-1005)...'
scripts.postbuild: echo 'CSS minification complete. Artifacts ready for S3 upload and CloudFront distribution.'
scripts.verify: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const css=fs.readFileSync('WebContent/styles.css','utf8'); const lines=css.split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim()); if(lines.length<=2){console.log('PASS: styles.css is minified (' + fs.statSync('WebContent/styles.css').size + ' bytes)')}else{console.error('FAIL: styles.css is NOT minified (' + lines.length + ' non-empty lines)');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify && echo 'All CSS files verified as minified for AWS CloudFront CDN delivery'

cloudReadiness.ruleName: CSS Files Not Minified for Production
cloudReadiness.strategy: Integrate CSS Minification in AWS CodePipeline with S3 and CloudFront Delivery
cloudReadiness.description: CSS minification step integrated into AWS CodePipeline build stage using Clean-CSS. Minified CSS artifacts are deployed to S3 and served via CloudFront for reduced bandwidth and faster CDN delivery across global regions. All 30 flagged non-minified CSS property declarations (source lines 267-338) are resolved by minifying the entire styles.css into a single optimized line.
